hints.title: Hierarchical Structure Linearization
hints.text: N-ary tree nodes possess an arbitrary number of branches. Recording each node value alongside its immediate child count creates an unambiguous linear encoding.

hints.title: Value-Length Pair Sequence Representation
hints.text: Serialize each node as its value followed by the integer count of its children. Deserialization pops the value, pops the child count, and recursively reconstructs the children.

hints.title: Token Stream Blueprint
hints.text: In serialize: depth-first search appending str(node.val) and str(len(node.children)), then recurse for each child. In deserialize: split string into tokens; pop val, pop count, create Node(val), loop count times appending recursive child results.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total nodes in N-ary tree
complexity.notes: Visits each node once in linear encoding and decoding passes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Omitting explicit child degree counts causes ambiguity when intermediate nodes have differing fanouts.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Token pair encoding [val, childCount] uses exact 2N integers without trailing null padding.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clean recursive reconstruction using token streams or queues.

solutions.approach: Token Pair Pre-Order Encoding and Recursive Stream Decoding
